notes_for_editor: Only three records exist for Neblett: the Forest Fire Lookout Association Texas list and its San Jacinto County page (type Unk, status Gone, no NHLR or FFLOS entry shown) and the tnlandforms.us tower map (same coordinates, datasheet BL2191, no date). No build date, height, design, staffing, fire, access or current-site source was found, so no dated events are recorded and the access level is omitted. The brief's record (name, county, coordinates, gone status, unknown kind, unknown access) matches the sources; no corrections. The name closely resembles Nebletts Creek (Neblett vs Nebletts), but no source links the two, so the story does not claim a connection. Search budget overrun: three websearch.py calls (budget two) and seven page reads (budget six); the Texas Escapes and firetower.org pages gave nothing usable for this site.
